title: Group Getaway | 5BR Heated Pool + Arcade
description:
☀️ Space to Gather. Room to Play. Arizona Sun Included.
Perfect for families, reunions, or group trips, this inviting home blends comfort with fun. Spend your days poolside, challenge each other in the arcade and foosball room, or relax in the bright, open living areas. The kitchen comes fully stocked, Wi-Fi is fast, and smart TVs keep everyone entertained. Centrally located near ASU, Tempe Town Lake, and Mill Ave—this is an easy, sun-filled escape built for making memories together.

 The space 
What Guests Love Most

🌴 Private Backyard Oasis
Large fenced backyard with a sparkling pool, firepit lounge, outdoor dining, BBQ grill, and classic lawn games—perfect for sunny days and relaxed desert nights. Towering palms create shade, privacy, and an unbeatable Arizona vibe.
(Pool heating available by request for an additional fee)

🎮 Fun for All Ages
Dedicated game room with foosball, Pac-Man arcade, cornhole, ladderball, and Giant Jenga—ideal for kids, teens, and competitive adults alike.

🛏 Room for Everyone
5 spacious bedrooms + 3 full bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 16 guests, with multiple gathering areas so your group can spread out or come together with ease.

🍳 Fully Stocked Kitchen + Coffee Station
Cook effortlessly with stainless cookware, Instant Pot, blender, rice cooker, toaster, and full dishware (including kid-friendly plates & cups). Start mornings right with a Starbucks-style coffee bar featuring K-cups, ground coffee, creamer, and sugar.

📶 Work, Stream & Stay Connected
Fast high-speed Wi-Fi and Smart TV make it easy to stream, work remotely, or unwind after a full day in the sun.

🌞 Prime Tempe Location
Quiet, family-friendly neighborhood just minutes from ASU, Mill Ave, Tempe Town Lake, Papago Park, sports complexes, golf courses, pickleball facilities, dining, and shopping.

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps up to 16)

Primary Suite: King bed + ensuite bathroom
Bedroom 2: Queen bed
Bedroom 3: Queen bed
Bedroom 4: Bunk setup (great for kids & teens)
Bedroom 5: Additional sleeping space ideal for groups

Premium linens | Smart TVs | Ample storage

🌴 Backyard Features

🔥 Firepit lounge under string lights
🏊 Private pool (heated by request)
🎯 Cornhole, ladderball & Giant Jenga
🍽 Outdoor dining + BBQ grill
🛋 Lounge seating & shaded areas
🌴 Mature palms for privacy & photo-worthy vibes

🎉 Perfect For

• Family reunions & multi-generational trips
• Friend getaways & milestone celebrations
• Sports tournaments & visiting ASU families
• Local staycations or extended Arizona escapes

👋 What to Expect

✔ Entire home is yours—no shared spaces
✔ Superhost-level communication
✔ Self check-in
✔ Washer & dryer
✔ Free driveway + street parking

 Guest access 
You’ll have full, exclusive access to the entire property, except for the garage.

Parking: Room for two cars in the driveway. Street parking is available but requires a permit Mon–Fri (one temporary pass is available—please ask in advance, and we’ll leave it out).

Check-in / Check-out: Self check-in via smart lock or keypad; we’ll send detailed instructions in advance.

Shared Areas: None—this is your private home during your stay.

Local Amenities: We’ll provide a guidebook with neighborhood highlights, recommended restaurants, grocery stores, and concierge services.

 Other things to note 
🚫 No parties, pets, or smoking

🏊 Pool & Guest Safety
• No diving — pool depth varies
• Children must be supervised at all times
• Posted pool rules are on-site and must be followed
Your safety matters to us—thank you for helping keep everyone safe and relaxed.

🔥 Pool Heating / Spa Fees
• $75 per night for pool heating
• 3-night minimum when heat is requested
• Must be arranged prior to arrival
(Heating availability is weather-dependent)

🔊 Noise Monitoring & Cameras
• Noise monitor is installed over the back patio dining area
– Measures decibel levels only
– No audio is recorded

• Exterior security cameras only (for safety & insurance compliance):
– Front door
– Front yard (SE corner)
– Pool area (NE corner)
🚫 No cameras inside the home

🧼 Cleaning & Respect for the Home
• Professionally cleaned and inspected after every stay
• Please leave the home in reasonable condition at checkout
This helps us maintain a high standard for all guests.

🏡 Permits & Compliance
• Fully licensed and permitted for short-term rental use
• Complies with all local safety and occupancy regulations
